notes.title: JETRUNNER OUT NOW
notes.content:
On Your Marks Jetrunners!


The Launch of JETRUNNER is finally here. Lace up your jet boots, grab your R.E.N.R.I.C blaster and rise to stardom. Watch the opening cinematic to JETRUNNER in our Day One celebration!


[previewyoutube="sysV-VWO62M;full"][/previewyoutube]


Reminder to watch these amazing creators during the launch week of JETRUNNER to see how they fair in our Launch Challenge on Speedrun.com. Tune in to @Bricky, @Simply, @CyYuVTuber (voice actor in the game!), @Ashmonsterftw, @MajinPhil, @Daltoosh, @RetroSpill, @Lyric, @Proxidist, @EZscape, and more on Twitch, all during the launch week of JETRUNNER.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964199/ecc88b2f442bc20c3f53f8a85767d4c77a008739.png"]

You can also take part in our special Launch Competition yourself!

The fastest marathon runners will earn a share of the $2,000 prize pool - but every verified challenger still walks away with digital rewards just for participating!



Start: September 4, 2025 @ 4:00 PM UTC / 12:00 PM ET
End: September 11, 2025 @ 11:59 PM UTC / 7:59 PM ET



All qualifying runs must be submitted through the official Challenge leaderboard on Speedrun.com.

Prize-eligible runs must be livestreamed as part of the submission process.

Note: Prizes may be subject to tax withholding depending on the winner’s country of residence.

All runners who submit a valid run - regardless of placement - will receive 1 Month of Speedrun.com Supporter and The “JETRUNNER” Title for your profile.

Supporter unlocks site-wide benefits and helps sustain the platform. Titles are exclusive flair only obtainable through official Challenges - once the challenge ends, they’re gone for good.



If you'd like to support the developers further, Riddlebit have done a special bundle DLC that unlocks the "Golden Gun" weapons skin. Run, jump, slide, and shoot in style! The Goldun Gun is purely cosmetic and will not in any razor blade hats being thrown at you.

notes.title: JETRUNNER Launch Trailer, Demo Update & Competition!
notes.content:
We're approaching the finish line!


The launch of a new action platformer is almost here. JETRUNNER launches on Steam September 4, 2025.

Join rising star, Nina, played by Sara Secora, on her journey to the top of the leaderboard. She’s joined by our star-studded cast with the voice talents of Matthew Mercer as the jetrunning commentator, Mick Acaster, and Alejandro Saab as Jacque, the childhood best friend of up-and-coming JETRUNNER, Nina.

Watch the launch trailer below that focuses on the growing relationship between Nina and her commentator, Mick, as Nina goes from rookie off the streets to a jetrunning legend.
[previewyoutube="mc--iNgQyow;full"][/previewyoutube]
Also, we have teamed up with Speedrun.com to host a launch competition where participants have the opportunity to claim from the $2000 prize pool.



The event will begin on launch day and starts September 4, 2025 @ 4:00 PM UTC / 12:00 PM ET. The event concludes on September 11, 2025 @ 11:59 PM UTC / 7:59 PM ET.



More details on how to take part will be announced on September 1, 2025.



We're also updating our demo at 18:00 (Oslo Time) so you can get a head start on the action, check here for the patch notes:

Limited access to 5 additional levels! See the start of New York featuring Matthew Mercer as commentator Mick Acaster.

Improved animations with revolutionary Jet Hands System

Added voice module to targets and a new volume slider for it

Movement changes

Swingbars now block wall running

Fixed issue with jumping in slopes

Fixed jump issue with coyote time

Made environments more alive with ambient sounds

Improved audio mix

Added coffee parrying

On-screen input actions should now display the correct input

Added a stats screen

More improvements and fixes

Removed coffee parrying



Godspeed jetrunners!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Attention jetrunners!


We're proud to share with you our brand new Gameplay & Release Date Trailer.

Described as Neon White meets Trackmania, JETRUNNER is proud to announce that it will be releasing on September 4, 2025.


[previewyoutube="pyDNTXhzQB8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: JETRUNNER New Trailer & Demo Update
notes.content:
Welcome Jetrunners!

As part of the Best Indie Games Showcase, JETRUNNER is back with a bang! An all new Official Announcement Trailer showcases the high-octane thrills JETRUNNER has to offer as you run, jump, slide, and shoot your way to becoming a jetrunning legend.

JETRUNNER boasts a star-studded cast including Matthew Mercer as the game’s commentator, Mick Acaster, and Alejandro Saab as protagonist Nina’s lifelong childhood friend, Jacques.

Get a taste of the action with the Official Announcement Trailer below:

[previewyoutube=qsL2ElBW1mA;full][/previewyoutube]

JETRUNNER will also be taking part in Steam Next Fest between June 9th-16th where players can take on an all-new demo build of the game with 5 challenging tracks to get their best time on.

New to the demo:

 Voice lines! Now our players can get the taste of JETRUNNER’s story and a glimpse of what’s coming in the full game.
 The public Demo will now have 5 tracks from the Prologue: The Queen of New York.
 Animated portrait of Nina:now she’s more alive than ever!

Why this update matters:
We’re getting JETRUNNER ready for the full launch (more news on that soon), and we want every new player to get a solid first impression of what the game is all about.

What’s next:
Meanwhile we’re working on more content for our players and polishing what’s already there! 

We’ve got lots more to showcase in the coming weeks so keep your eyes peeled for more JETRUNNER content!

Join the community Discord for sneak peaks and post your times.

Until next time, godspeed jetrunners

notes.title: Patch Notes 21/08/24
notes.content:
A new build for the JETRUNNER demo went live today with some new features, fixes and improvements! The demo store page is now live and open for reviews, so try out the demo now and leave a review if you'd like!

Changes

 Items will now respawn when used (after a short delay)

Note - We have observed several occurences where items have been used "unsuccessfully" and then the only option is to restart the level. In general, we want players to always be able to finish a level without restarting, and we believe this change helps with that.

 Changes to wall run settings

 Auto jump setting no longer dependent on hold input setting
 Auto jump when reaching the end of a wall should now work correctly when using the setting

 Option to show/hide build ID is now implemented
 Made some jumps more forgiving
 FIxed some performance issues
 Fixed weapon ammo counter not always rendering correctly
 You can now spice up the environment with some grafitti
 Other fixes and improvements

notes.title: Announcing: JETRUNNER REMASTERED!… No, wait, that can't be right?
notes.content:
You heard that right. JETRUNNER might be the first game in history to be remastered before it even releases.

“What? How? Why? Why?”

Listen, sometimes inspiration strikes at the strangest of times in the most unexpected of ways. Best not to think about it too hard, don’t you agree?

Shake? Shake. 🤝

The JETRUNNER REMASTERED update will hit the demo Friday, August 9, 2024 6:00 PM CEST.
The update features:

 JETRUNNER’s new art style
 New Arcade Map: Leaper
 A buff to sliding
 Etcetera!

(DISCLAIMER: The game will not the renamed to JETRUNNER REMASTERED. That was a joke.)
